part.text: Fixed. In `include/fmt/format.h:9796`, `group_digits` cast the raw value to unsigned, so negatives became huge two's-complement numbers. Now it uses `detail::make_write_int_arg` to extract the sign and absolute value, passing the `-` prefix to `write_int` (same approach as `loc_writer`). All 20 tests pass, including the negative-value `group_digits` cases.
